Eduardo Teodorani-Fabbri (born 1965, Rome) is an Italian-British corporate executive and scion of the Agnelli industrial dynasty, the son of Maria Sole Agnelli and Count Pio Teodorani-Fabbri. He served as Senior Vice President of Corporate Development at CNH Industrial, the Fiat/Stellantis subsidiary that encompasses agricultural and industrial machinery worldwide, and held board seats at IVECO SpA, Maserati SpA, and Fiat Chrysler Automobiles. He appeared alongside UK Prime Minister David Cameron at a CNH event in 2012 and chaired the Italian Chamber of Commerce and Industry for the UK from 2003 until his resignation in February 2026. According to Italian press reports, his name appears 1,251 times across the DOJ Volume 11 release of Jeffrey Epstein files, with 10 phone numbers and 2 addresses recorded on page 53 of Epstein's black book.

Documents from the DOJ release reveal a sustained personal relationship between Teodorani-Fabbri and Epstein spanning October 2009 to at least April 2019, conducted across Rome, Paris, Palm Beach, New York, and Epstein's Zorro Ranch in New Mexico. Teodorani functioned as Epstein's primary gateway to Italian elite society, brokering introductions to figures including Ugo Brachetti Peretti of API petroleum, real estate developer Paolo Barletta of Barletta Costruzioni, and Prince Fabio Borghese. He also served as a conduit for the introduction and sharing of young women, a pattern documented in multiple EFTA records. In a March 2019 message, Teodorani addressed Epstein as "Master" and requested he bring "the good ankle bambina with another good friend of your choice" to a party at the Peninsula Hotel in New York, five days after bringing Barletta to meet Epstein at 9 East 71st Street.

The Epstein relationship intersected with Teodorani-Fabbri's later career move to WRM Group, the FCA-regulated London investment firm founded by Raffaele Mincione, the principal defendant in the Vatican's 200 million EUR financial scandal. By 2019, Teodorani's executive assistant Karen Wolleaston was signing correspondence from WRM Group's offices at 51 Berkeley Square, coordinating meetings with Lesley Groff, Epstein's longtime personal assistant. On January 28, 2019, Epstein sent Teodorani a one-line email asking "Allesandro benedetti?" -- a query about the Italian operative linked to the SoftBank sabotage campaign -- just two days after Epstein had asked Brad Karp of Paul Weiss whether the firm represented Rajeev Misra. sections.title: The Agnelli Dynasty and Corporate Career
sections.content:
Eduardo Teodorani-Fabbri's significance within the Epstein network derives directly from his position within Italy's most powerful industrial family. His mother Maria Sole Agnelli was a daughter of Edoardo Agnelli, the founder of Fiat, making Eduardo a grandson of the dynasty that controlled one of Europe's largest conglomerates. The Agnelli empire, restructured through the Dutch holding company EXOR N.V. under the leadership of John Elkann (Maria Sole's great-nephew), encompasses Ferrari, Stellantis, CNH Industrial, Iveco, The Economist Group, and Juventus FC, with total assets exceeding 15 billion USD.

Teodorani-Fabbri held the position of Director and SVP at CNH U.K. Limited from May 2004 to November 2015, per UK Companies House records. SEC filings from May 2012 identify him as "Head of CNH Corporate Development" at a Basildon, UK facility event attended by Prime Minister David Cameron and Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg. An October 2013 SEC SC 13D filing from Exor S.p.A. lists him as a beneficial owner of 52,893 CNH Industrial shares alongside Sergio Marchionne and Alessandro Nasi. His broader board portfolio, confirmed through MarketScreener data, included directorships at IVECO SpA, Maserati SpA, Aon Italia SRL, Turk Traktor, and HippoGroup Cesenate SpA, a racecourse management company. He also served as Chairman or Vice President of the Italian Chamber of Commerce and Industry for the United Kingdom from September 2003 until his resignation in February 2026, a departure widely attributed in Italian media to the Epstein file releases.

This constellation of roles gave Teodorani-Fabbri access to multiple intersecting worlds: the Agnelli family's inner corporate governance, Italian political and business circles, London's financial establishment, and the broader European aristocratic social circuit. It was precisely this access that made him valuable to Epstein, who cultivated the relationship for a full decade.

sections.title: A Decade of Access: The Epstein Relationship (2009-2019)
sections.content:
The earliest documented contact between Teodorani-Fabbri and Epstein dates to October 2009, when Lesley Groff noted "Eduardo Teodorani has called again for you" (EFTA02438550). From this point forward, the EFTA corpus documents a relationship of remarkable continuity across ten years, four countries, and three successive employer affiliations for Teodorani (CNH, CNH Industrial, and WRM Group). The communications were mediated through a succession of four executive assistants -- Denise Jackson, Karen Bird, Lea Ardimento, and Karen Wolleaston -- all of whom coordinated directly with Groff.

The relationship escalated rapidly. By the summer of 2010, Teodorani visited Epstein's Zorro Ranch in New Mexico from August 10 to 13, accompanied by his partner Davina de Forest. While Teodorani was at the ranch, Epstein emailed Peter Mandelson, the former UK Business Secretary: "eduardo tedodorani and annabel nielson, are here at ranch with me." In the same exchange, Epstein pressed Mandelson for intelligence on the Agnelli family leadership: "Get his views on john elkann and luca di montezemolo, both of whom I have been talking to today" (EFTA02423612). The subject line read "angnelli, ferrarri fiat etc." This reveals a characteristic Epstein technique: hosting a contact socially while simultaneously mining that contact's network through separate channels.

In August 2009, Epstein identified Teodorani's precise value: "david stem is not ferrari, eduardo tedouraoni is ferari" (EFTA02436117). This designation of Teodorani as his "Ferrari connection" was operationally accurate -- in March 2018, Teodorani arranged a private visit to the Ferrari factory and Fiorano test track for Epstein and behavioral economist Dan Ariely, coordinated through the Ferrari President's office (EFTA02518985). By September 2017, when Teodorani photographed Lapo Elkann, Epstein instructed him: "you can tell him we are friends," positioning himself as connected to the Elkann branch of the Agnelli dynasty.

Regular meetings continued through Rome (July 2011, a lunch at a seaside restaurant), Paris (September-October 2013, June-July 2014, October 2014, June 2018), and New York (February 2019). Teodorani sent annual Christmas wine gifts to Epstein in 2017 and 2018. In December 2013, an email to Epstein reported: "I am in London with edu! We went to another shooting at mark Getty place! Where are you?? On Monday we will go to Rome!" (EFTA02381210) -- placing Teodorani and an unnamed companion at Mark Getty's country estate.

sections.title: Brokering Italian Elite Access
sections.content:
Teodorani-Fabbri's core function within Epstein's network was as a broker of introductions to Italian industrialists, aristocrats, and business figures who would otherwise have been beyond Epstein's reach. The documentary record reveals at least three major brokered relationships, each following a similar pattern: Teodorani made the initial introduction, Epstein evaluated the commercial potential, and the relationship was then managed through Epstein's executive assistants.

The most commercially significant was Ugo Brachetti Peretti, co-owner of Anonima Petroli Italiana (API), one of Italy's oldest petroleum companies. Teodorani introduced Brachetti Peretti to Epstein, and both appeared at Epstein's July 19, 2014 Paris party alongside former IMF Managing Director Dominique Strauss-Kahn. Within weeks, Brachetti Peretti sent Epstein a corporate presentation (EFTA02709964) and began requesting introductions to "your arab friend" for a potential partnership (EFTA02714176). Epstein brokered a March 2015 Paris lunch between Brachetti Peretti and Ariane de Rothschild, the Swiss financier. According to Italian outlet Dagospia, Epstein demanded a verbal-only agreement for "5% of all money received" as his brokerage fee. API was eventually sold to Azerbaijan's SOCAR for approximately 3 billion EUR in 2025.

The second documented introduction involved Paolo Barletta, CEO of Gruppo Barletta/Barletta Costruzioni, one of Italy's major real estate developers, who also co-founded Arsenale SpA luxury rail cruises with Nicola Bulgari. Teodorani first forwarded Barletta's "U-First" startup pitch to Epstein in August 2015; Epstein declined but said "always send me alternatives" (EFTA02490136). In February 2019, Teodorani arranged a formal introduction at 9 East 71st Street. Karen Wolleaston described Barletta to Groff as "a business associate who Eduardo wants to introduce to Mr Epstein" (EFTA02277792). The meeting took place on February 28, 2019 at 3:30 PM, just 4.5 months before Epstein's arrest.

The third figure was Prince Fabio Borghese, whom Teodorani described as a "collector of women" according to Italian press reports. Borghese received VIP treatment in New York in late April 2019, with Epstein instructing his driver Jojo Fontanilla to "have jojo drive him around the next two days, suburban" (EFTA02283253). This visit occurred just 2.5 months before Epstein's final arrest.

sections.title: The Exchange of Women and Social Introductions
sections.content:
Beyond business introductions, the documentary record reveals a persistent pattern of Teodorani-Fabbri and Epstein exchanging introductions to young women, flowing in both directions. On September 22, 2013, Epstein emailed Teodorani: "eduardo, my great and very beautiful friend yfke that i have copied on this email, now lives in london, i think you two should meet" (EFTA02373257). Yfke Sturm, a Dutch model, had maintained intensive contact with Epstein since December 2011 and publicly acknowledged in February 2026 that the relationship was a "serious misjudgment."

Traffic flowed the other direction as well. In January 2014, Teodorani forwarded an email from Karyna Pshenychna to Epstein containing a romantic Italian aphorism: "La vera genialita non e conquistare una donna gia desiderata da tutti, ma scovarne una preziosa in un essere ignoto" -- "True genius is not conquering a woman already desired by all, but discovering a precious one in an unknown being" (EFTA02676878). In November 2017, Teodorani told Epstein about Astrid Gill Casrez, describing her as "one of the smartest woman that I know" and noting "she is trying to call you now." Epstein replied: "she can email me or call anytime" (EFTA02564633).

Scheduling records reveal suggestive overlaps. On June 12, 2013, Groff noted "Eduardo Teodorani on Thursday June 13" alongside "Lola Mignon to arrive around 8pm on Thurs June 13" (EFTA02571476), scheduling a woman's arrival on the same evening as Teodorani's visit. In August 2013, Teodorani forwarded Love Magazine photos of model Alana Bunte from "on the boat," prompting Epstein's reply "lucky you" (EFTA02573775). Italian press identified Teodorani and Brachetti Peretti as "Italian intermediaries" who attempted to recruit model Chiara Baschetti from Cesena for Epstein in 2015-2016, offering an exclusive dinner with Woody Allen in Paris as the lure; Baschetti declined all advances.

The most explicit communication came on March 1, 2019, when Teodorani wrote to Epstein: "Master we wait the good ankle bambina with another good friend of your choice!!! Peninsula will be our party HQ tonight!" In Italian, "bambina" means "girl," while "good ankle" appears to reference physical appearance. Teodorani's use of "Master" as a form of address for Epstein, combined with the request for Epstein to choose which women to bring, reveals a dynamic in which Teodorani was simultaneously a peer in social standing and a supplicant in the relationship's actual power structure.

sections.title: Epstein and the Agnelli Fortune
sections.content:
While Teodorani-Fabbri provided Epstein with access to Italian society, Epstein simultaneously worked to exploit the broader Agnelli financial structure through separate channels. On April 19, 2015, Epstein emailed "Jabor Y" (likely Jabor Al-Thani of Qatar): "shabaz could look at the details of EXOR. the owner of cushman, agnelli family holding. they just bid for an re insurance co last week, they will spin off ferrari this year. and will have fiat chrysler.maserati. most of their money is liquid. 15billion or so" (EFTA02504407). This message demonstrates Epstein leveraging intelligence gained through his Teodorani relationship to pitch the Agnelli corporate structure to Gulf investors.

On the same day, a contact emailed Epstein about John Elkann, the CEO of EXOR and de facto head of the Agnelli dynasty: "has heard great things about him from a friend; I know that he is Lapo's brother.. what do you think?" The contact then wrote: "I think he is the new target. How do we meet him? Not through Edu for sure" (EFTA02389138). "Edu" is Eduardo Teodorani-Fabbri. The decision to bypass Teodorani suggests that Epstein's circle understood Teodorani's position was as a useful but limited access point -- sufficiently connected to provide intelligence and social introductions, but not positioned closely enough to the Elkann branch to broker a direct approach to the family's real power center without raising alarms.

Epstein's fascination with the Agnelli world extended to culture and aesthetics. In January 2018, he asked "what was the name of the house in the agnelli movie" (EFTA02326741), referring to a documentary. By May 2018, he was requesting floor plans for Chateau de l'Horizon, the Agnelli family's famous Cote d'Azur property, from Ariane de Rothschild, telling his architect about using it as inspiration. Rothschild pushed back: "Are you sure its Agnelli's house? I thought it belonged to the Saudis. Its a horrible location" (EFTA02650568). SEC filings confirm Teodorani's financial stake in the family enterprise: as of October 2013, he held 52,893 CNH Industrial shares (8,636 owned outright, 853 vesting, and 43,404 in exercisable options), listed in an Exor S.p.A. SC 13D alongside Sergio Marchionne. He sold 2,885 shares in February 2015 for approximately $22,300.

sections.title: WRM Group and the Vatican Connection
sections.content:
At some point between 2015 and 2018, Teodorani-Fabbri transitioned from CNH Industrial to WRM Group, an FCA-regulated investment firm headquartered at 51 Berkeley Square, London, founded in 2009 by Raffaele Mincione. WRM Capinvest Ltd (UK company 07990219, formerly Capital Investment Advisors Ltd) operates as the group's advisory arm. The transition is documented through Karen Wolleaston's email signatures: earlier correspondence bears the CNH Industrial address, while a February 2019 signature reads "Karen Wolleaston, EA to Eduardo Teodorani Fabbri, WRM Group, Authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, 51 Berkeley Square, London W1J 5BB" (EFTA02277129).

Mincione is the principal defendant in the Vatican's financial scandal, which centered on the Secretariat of State's investment of approximately 200 million EUR in Mincione's Athena Global Opportunities Fund and the subsequent purchase of 60 Sloane Avenue, a London property. The Vatican trial, which began in 2021, involved charges of embezzlement, fraud, and abuse of office. Teodorani's role as Senior Advisor at WRM Group alongside Mincione represents a continuation of the pattern established throughout his career: operating at the nexus of Italian aristocratic finance, British corporate structures, and high-level networking. He also served as Director of Margherita Distribuzione SpA, a hypermarket company whose CEO Carlo Maggi was simultaneously a WRM Group executive.

In March 2019, Teodorani incorporated ANIVAD Consulting Ltd (UK company 11887450), registered at 96 Pollards Oak Road, Oxted, Surrey. The company name is "DAVINA" reversed -- a reference to his wife Davina de Forest. ANIVAD operates alongside his WRM Group advisory role as a personal consulting vehicle, classified under SIC code 82990 (Other business support services).

sections.title: Bannon, Benedetti, and Political Intelligence
sections.content:
In November 2018, Epstein brokered an introduction between Teodorani-Fabbri and Steve Bannon, who was then building "The Movement," a Brussels-based organization aimed at fostering European populist-nationalist politics. On November 12, Epstein emailed Teodorani: "bannon will be in oxford on friday." Teodorani replied eagerly: "I would like very much to see him." Karen Wolleaston followed up to confirm logistics, asking whether the meeting would take place in Oxford or London (EFTA02615334). The introduction is significant in its timing -- Bannon was actively courting Matteo Salvini's Lega party and other Italian populist forces, and Teodorani's Agnelli/Fiat connections provided access to the Italian political-industrial establishment that Bannon's network sought to influence. Epstein served as the bridge between an American political operative and a European industrial insider, a role he repeated across multiple contexts.

More significant was Epstein's January 28, 2019 query to Teodorani: "Allesandro benedetti?" (EFTA02628256). This terse one-line email asked about Alessandro Benedetti, the Italian operator who had orchestrated a sabotage campaign against SoftBank executives on behalf of Rajeev Misra. The timing is critical: just two days earlier, on January 26, Epstein had emailed Brad Karp, Chairman of Paul Weiss, calling Carlos Ghosn "a very very not good guy" and then asking "Rajeev misra do you represent?" Karp replied: "Sort of. Spoke to him yesterday." Within 48 hours, Epstein thus connected three threads -- the Ghosn arrest, Misra and SoftBank, and Benedetti -- using Teodorani as his intelligence source on the Italian side of the equation. Both Teodorani and Benedetti appeared on Epstein's September 2013 Paris contact list (EFTA02575400), suggesting they may have traveled in overlapping Italian social circles in France.

The query also illuminates the structural difference between the Agnelli and De Benedetti industrial dynasties. The De Benedetti family, rivals to the Agnellis, later sold their media group GEDI to the Elkann-controlled EXOR. Epstein was, in effect, working both sides of Italian corporate power simultaneously, using Teodorani for access to the Agnelli orbit and maintaining separate contact with the De Benedetti circle through Paris social networks.

sections.content:
